blocks.title: Drive Strix from the chat, watch it in the tab
blocks.description: The sandbox, the bundled toolchain, the skill library and the findings ledger are served by the plugin's own local service, and the model calls them through strix_* tools. The panel is a window on that same run, so it follows the host conversation instead of living beside it. No second API key.

showcase.assistant_reply: Sandbox up; one critical IDOR filed.

items.title: Tools, right in the chat
items.description: strix_environment, strix_sandbox_start, strix_exec, strix_file_finding, strix_report and 21 more come from the plugin's local service, in the order an assessment needs them.

items.title: The real toolchain
items.description: nmap, nuclei, ffuf, sqlmap, subfinder, Katana, Caido, agent-browser, trivy, gitleaks and trufflehog, inside one sandbox.

items.title: Strix's own skills
items.description: 13 tool manuals ship with the plugin; with strix-agent installed it reads the engine's full library instead, loading what matches the target.

items.title: Your model, no new key
items.description: The console's loop runs on ctx.ai: the model and plan you already picked in Astravia.

items.title: Toggle the capsule, name the target
items.description: The Strix capsule in the composer puts the tools on this turn; target, scope and instruction go into the same message, with no skill names to memorise.

items.title: Or open the tab on the same run
items.description: The panel reads the same sandbox and ledger; as soon as the host turn starts it leaves the launch screen and follows.

items.title: Watch and read
items.description: Commands run in the sandbox and appear in the trace; each confirmed issue lands in Findings with proof and fix.

blocks.content: Only scan systems you are authorised to test. Strix sends real attack traffic to the targets you give it.
